Off Calendar Aug-18-2008 Case Settled - Set For Crc 3.1385 Hrg On Oct-19-10 At 10:00 A.M. In Dept 212
MINI MINUTES: This matter comes on calendar this day, having been assigned from the Presiding Judge Dept. 206 for Court Trial/Prove-Up Hearing. Commissioner William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, Reporter: Lois Jones, CSR #3689.

Stephen McDonagh, Esq. appeared for plaintiff U-Save Plumbing & Hardware, Inc.
Ken Leong, owner of U-Save Plumbing & Hardware, Inc., was placed under oath and examined.
Marco Acosta, Esq. appeared with defendant Stanley Nickle, individually and dba Tromberg Royal Plumbing & Heating, who was placed under oath and examined. Mr. Acosta also appeared for defendant Westco Service.
Notice of Time and Placed of Trial was filed on May 1, 2008

The Settlement Agreement reached by the parties was read into the record by Mr.McDonagh. In accordance with the terms of said agreement, defendants Stanley Nickle, individually and dba Tromberg Royal Plumbing & Heating and Westco Service shall pay plaintiff U-Save Plumbing & Hardware, Inc. the sum of $35,000.00 as follows:

$5,000.00 due on or before 5:00 p.m. on August 25, 2008, and $5,000.00 due on or before 5:00 p.m. on September 2, 2008. Commencing on September 15, 2008, and continuing on the 15th day of each month thereafter, defendants shall pay to plaintiff the sum of $1,000.00 per month, until the balance is paid in full. Terms of this Settlement Agreement shall be reduced to a written document.

If defendants fail to comply with the terms of the Settlement Agreement set forth above, plaintiff may obtain Entry of Judgment in the original amount of $35,000.00 (less payments received) on ex parte application, within three days of the default by defendants.

Matter is continued to October 19, 2010 @ 10:00 a.m. in Department 212 on the CRC 3.1385 Calendar.

Settlement Agreement reached by the parties is approved by the Court.
